assets.description: excavated foundation pit with stepped earth walls, retaining piles and foundation footings. No above-ground building, no finished landscaping.
ground-zero foundation: full reinforced concrete ground slab with rebar starters and short column stubs, low orange site fence. No upper floors.

structural frame at HALF the final building height, exposed concrete slabs and columns, incomplete walls, one safety-orange tower crane, unfinished worksite. Compress crane height so whole sprite height is at most 1.3 times plot width.
fully topped-out shell at final height, full grey concrete structure covered in scaffolding and green safety netting, no finished facade or windows, orange site fence. No crane needed.

abandoned unfinished HALF-height concrete shell, weather stains, rusted exposed rebar, one idle rusty-orange tower crane, faded orange site fence, some sparse weeds. No completed facade or windows. Total height including crane at most 1.3 times plot width.
